subject: Strategic sponsor readout — investment criteria, evidence needs & escalation triggers
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@altura-fin.com>, Diego Ramos <diego.ramos@altura-fin.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Strategic sponsor readout — investment criteria, evidence needs & escalation triggers

Hi Elena / Diego —

Thanks for taking time today. Quick post-call recap so we’re aligned with the exec sponsors and procurement path. I’ve highlighted the business objectives, the top technical / compliance gaps you mentioned, and proposed next steps (pilot entry criteria + owners). Please reply with any corrections.

Business outcomes (what Altura wants to measure):
- Reduce manual document review time by ~60% for retail loan approvals (target: 3 weeks to pilot ROI)
- Improve accuracy of risk flagging, aiming for <5% false positives at pilot scope
- Lower per-request inference cost sufficiently to justify 1:1 throughput for peak windows

Top pain points you called out:
- Legacy pipeline: long preprocessing latency and brittle NER for domain terms (affects throughput)
- Auditability: legal needs immutable logs + short SOC2 evidence window for demo to compliance team
- Contracting: procurement requires a clearly scoped pilot SOW, a data handling appendix, and an SLA exception approval flow for pilot traffic

Sponsor & decision path (as we heard it):
- Executive sponsor: Elena Morales (Product) — buying criteria: accuracy metrics, audit evidence, time-to-value
- Technical sponsor / CTO touch: Diego Ramos — will sign off on data retention and onboarding plan
- Procurement + Legal will do parallel review once pilot SOW is agreed; expect 2–3 week review window

Risks / escalation triggers (if we hit these, we’ll escalate to Ben / CRO):
- If SOC2 snapshot cannot be delivered within 5 business days of request
- If initial integration exceeds 3 engineering days of work per endpoint (beyond the agreed prep work)
- If pilot metrics at week 2 are >20% off target accuracy

Proposed pilot entry criteria (what we need to start):
1) Sample dataset (anonymized) + data spec from Altura (Diego)
2) Signed pilot SOW (attached draft)
3) Confirmation of required SOC2 evidence; we provided a snapshot (attached) and a redaction plan
4) Exec confirmation from Elena to proceed to pilot (email acceptance is fine)

Attachments: pilot_scope_v1.pdf (scope & metrics), requested_SOC2_snapshot.pdf (redwood snapshot), draft_SOW_Altura.docx

Next steps / owners:
- Diego: send anonymized sample dataset and schema by EOD Thu (2027-07-01) — Diego owns
- Monica: I’ll route the SOW + cleaned SOC2 snapshot to procurement/legal and provide an annotated checklist by Fri
- Ben: happy to join procurement enablement call next week to accelerate commercial terms if needed
- Elena: confirmation to proceed (email reply) to lock pilot start date (aiming week of 2027-07-11)

Thanks — I’ll consolidate any edits and send a one-page pilot MOU for signature.

Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
phone: (415) 555-0198
Attachment: pilot_scope_v1.pdf
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Elena Morales <elena.morales@altura-fin.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Diego Ramos <diego.ramos@altura-fin.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Strategic sponsor readout — investment criteria, evidence needs & escalation triggers

Thanks Sean — adding a couple of technical clarifications and an engineering ask that will affect schedule: 

1) Integration effort: based on your call notes, we estimate 2 full engineering days for the first endpoint (ingest + schema mapping) and 1 day for subsequent endpoints if the schema is stable. If there are additional data transformations we’ll need to revisit the timeline.

2) Logging / audit: we can provide token-level request/response logs and an exportable KV cache trace for the pilot. For procurement, we’ll include an appendix describing retention and redaction policies.

I attached a short SOW template with explicit milestones (integration, week 1 evaluation, week 3 checkpoint). It’s intentionally narrow to reduce legal review time.

Attachment: draft_SOW_Altura.docx

I’ll be available for a 30-min procurement enablement call next Tue (2027-07-06) 10:00–10:30 PT if that aligns with legal. If procurement prefers a different time tag Ben and I can flex.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachment: draft_SOW_Altura.docx

Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Strategic sponsor readout — investment criteria, evidence needs & escalation triggers

Sean / Monica —

Thanks — this is helpful and aligns with our internal readout. A few clarifications from my side: 

- Piloting scope: we’ll start with the consumer retail loan product vertical (approx. 120k requests/month sample). If the week 3 checkpoint meets thresholds we’ll expand.
- Audit evidence: procurement asked for a SOC2 snapshot and an explanation of what fields are redacted; your snapshot looks fine but Legal wants the redaction plan formalized in the appendix.
- Timeline: our commercial committee meets on Friday 2027-07-09; we need the signed pilot MOU by 2027-07-07 to have a shot at their agenda.

I’m adding one more ask: can Redwood provide a short note on fallback behavior (what happens when the model returns an ambiguous score) — Diego, can you confirm whether that needs to be in SOW?

Diego: looping you to confirm schema delivery and the internal tech review cadence.

Elena Morales
VP Product | Altura Financial

On Wed, Jun 30, 2027 at 16:40 Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai> wrote:

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@altura-fin.com>, Diego Ramos <diego.ramos@altura-fin.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Strategic sponsor readout — investment criteria, evidence needs & escalation triggers

Elena / Diego —

Appreciate the quick confirmation. Two quick answers and the plan to keep procurement on schedule: 

1) Fallback behavior: Redwood’s default is a confidence-thresholded output with explicit fallback code paths. For the pilot we’ll include a default fallback policy in the SOW: if score < threshold, route to human review queue plus include structured rationale with the response (this will be in the appendix). Monica will include the fallback language in the updated SOW.

2) SOC2 & redaction: Monica will add the redaction plan in the appendix and I’ll attach the SOC2 snapshot to the MOU submission. We can fast-track a compliance attestation call if Legal needs it.

Immediate next steps (timeline to hit your committee deadline):
- Diego: dataset + schema by EOD today (2027-07-01) — kicks off integration work
- Monica: updated SOW (inc. fallback appendix & delivered milestones) by tomorrow COB (2027-07-02)
- Ben: I’ll have Ben join the procurement call on 2027-07-06 if the committee needs commercial context
- Elena: if you can confirm the committee window is firm, we’ll aim to circulate the signed MOU by 2027-07-07.

If any of these slips, flag immediately and we’ll escalate.

Best —

Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
phone: (415) 555-0198
